name: perfecto-prototype
description: Modern prototype of PERFECTO accounting PWA

scripts.prebuild: bash -lc 'if [ ! -d ./_framework ] || [ ! -f ./js/perfecto-db.js ]; then rm -rf ../tmp_unzip && mkdir -p ../tmp_unzip && unzip -o ../Perfecto-Next-0.2.0-preview.1-source.zip -d ../tmp_unzip >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; SRC=$(find ../tmp_unzip -type d -path "*/src/Perfecto.Pwa/wwwroot" -print -quit); if [ -n "$SRC" ]; then cp -r "$SRC"/* .; else echo "wwwroot not found in ZIP"; fi; fi'
